correctness.rationale: Reconstructed K3,4 with 24 directed incidence primitives and enumerated exactly 12,800 rooted-forest faces (including empty), f=(24,234,1192,3357,4968,3024). Independent greedy-element matching gave 5,887 augmented pairs, 297 critical 4-faces, 729 critical 5-faces, and acyclicity after topologically sorting all 60,480 Hasse covers. Independently recursively computed the SIGNED integer 297x729 Morse boundary (4,162 nonzero entries, all unit magnitude). Exact unimodular elimination found 297 unit pivots and 432 zero columns. The basepoint+4,5-cell CW complex has attaching maps classified by π4 of a 4-sphere wedge, permitting 297 degree-one cancellations. This proves the integral homotopy wedge, not merely mod-2 homology or Euler characteristic.

evidence: Scoville–Zaremsky Theorem 4.3 supplies only lower connectivity; Jojić complete-source/essentially-tree hypotheses not met.
